Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare 
 disp_format_mask varchar2(50);
begin
 if error_code = 40100 -- at first record
 then
 show_error('1700');
 elsif error_code = 40102 -- record must be entered first
 then
 show_error('1701');
 elsif error_code = 40200 -- field protected against update
 then
 show_error('1702');
 elsif error_code = 40201 -- field is full
 then
 show_error('1703');
 elsif error_code = 40202 -- field must be entered
 then
 show_error('0080');
 elsif error_code = 40207 -- must be in range
 then
 show_error('1704');
 elsif error_code = 40208 -- form in query mode, cant update
 then
 show_error('1705');
 elsif error_code = 40200 -- field protected against update
 then
 show_error('5050');
 elsif error_code in (40400,40406,40407)-- transaction committed
 then
 show_error('8010');
 elsif error_code = 40401 -- no changes to commit
 then
 show_error('8013');
 elsif error_code in (50002,50003,50004, -- invalid date
 50011,50012,50021,50023,50025,50026,0)
 then
 if upper(substr(get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK),1,2)) ='FX' then
 disp_format_mask:=substr(get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK),3);
 else
 disp_format_mask:= get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK);
 end if;
 disp_format_mask := translate(disp_format_mask, 'R', 'Y');
 show_error('0022',disp_format_mask);
 elsif error_code in (50006,50007,50009, -- invalid number
 50013,50014,50015,50016,50020)
 then
 show_error('1707');
 elsif error_code in (50017,50018,50019,50022) -- invalid time
 then
 show_error('5016');
 elsif error_code in ('40209','40735') then
 null;

 /*Added by HCLC for removing double message */ 
 elsif error_code = 41000 then -- This function is not available
 null;
 else
 message(substr(error_type||'-'||to_char (error_code)
 ||': '||error_text,1,80));
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 check_package_failure;
 end;

Trigger.Name: KEY-COMMIT
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 execute_trigger('WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM');
 check_package_failure;
 go_record('1');
 loop
 if :choose = 'X' then
 begin
 select 'x'
 into :GLOBAL.x
 from valid_donor_overrides
 where PRODUCT_TYPE = :product_type 
 and DONOR_DECISION_CODE = :donor_decision_code
 and NVL(ATTRIB_GROUP,'@') = NVL(:attrib_group, '@')
 and NVL(ATTRIB_CODE,'@') = NVL(:attrib_code, '@')
 and INTER_CODE = :inter_code;
 --audit_key = :audit_key; -- IM 307
 
 
 
 update valid_donor_overrides
 set --product_type = :product_type,
 --donor_decision_code = :donor_decision_code,
 --attrib_group = :attrib_group,
 --attrib_code = :attrib_code,
 --inter_code = :inter_code,
 inter_type = :inter_type,
 override_desc = :override_desc,
 eff_date = :eff_date,
 term_date = :term_date,
 last_modified_date = sysdate,
 program_id = :banner.prog_name
 where PRODUCT_TYPE = :product_type 
 and DONOR_DECISION_CODE = :donor_decision_code
 and NVL(ATTRIB_GROUP,'@') = NVL(:attrib_group, '@')
 and NVL(ATTRIB_CODE,'@') = NVL(:attrib_code, '@')
 and INTER_CODE = :inter_code;
 --audit_key = :audit_key;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 BEGIN
 insert into valid_donor_overrides
 (product_type,
 donor_decision_code,
 inter_code,
 inter_type,
 override_desc,
 attrib_group,
 attrib_code,
 eff_date,
 term_date,
 last_modified_date,
 program_id,
 audit_key)
 values
 (:product_type,
 :donor_decision_code,
 :inter_code,
 :inter_type,
 :override_desc,
 :attrib_group,
 :attrib_code,
 :eff_date,
 :term_date,
 sysdate,
 :banner.prog_name,
 :audit_key);
 EXCEPTION
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 END;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 
 
 select last_modified_date
 into :move_date
 from valid_donor_overrides
 where PRODUCT_TYPE = :product_type 
 and DONOR_DECISION_CODE = :donor_decision_code
 and NVL(ATTRIB_GROUP,'@') = NVL(:attrib_group, '@')
 and NVL(ATTRIB_CODE,'@') = NVL(:attrib_code, '@')
 and INTER_CODE = :inter_code; 
 --audit_key = :audit_key; -- IM 307
 
 :program_id := :banner.prog_name;
 
 end if;

 exit when :system.last_record = 'TRUE';
 down;
 end loop;
 :system.message_level := 5;
 check_pass;
 if not form_success then
 clear_form(full_rollback);
 execute_trigger('key-clrfrm');
 show_error('0230');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 show_error('8010');
 check_package_failure;
 down;
 end if;
 clear_block;
 execute_query;
 :system.message_level := 0;
end;
